import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen2, stress2, planner, probability, controller, verify
from fractions import Fraction

bad=0
t0=time.time()
for seed in range(40):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    case=gen2.mid_case(rng)
    out=controller.run(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[case]}).encode())
    res=out['results'][0]
    preds=res['predictions']; thr=res['thresholds']
    m=planner.Model(case,preds,thr)
    m.pairs=planner.eligible_pairs(m)
    lo,hi,_=m.scan_coverage()
    if hi>=len(m.rset):
        continue
    wp=m.wants(m.rset[hi])
    arcs=planner.arc_list(m,m.pairs,wp)
    # direct route
    nodes=planner._reachable(planner._direct_residual(m,wp,arcs), m.K, m.K)
    ok_direct=planner.cut_holds(arcs,wp,nodes)
    ok_proj=planner.cut_holds(arcs,wp,res['cut'])
    same_res=verify is not None
    if not (ok_direct and ok_proj):
        bad+=1; print('seed',seed,'direct',ok_direct,'proj',ok_proj)
    # also check the reported cut satisfies the same predicate through the verifier logic
print('checked 40, bad', bad, 'time %.1f'%(time.time()-t0))
PYEOF
